title: Container Bookings: Recording Late Shipping Instructions
content:
When shipping instructions for a Container Bookings sailing miss the SI cut-off but still arrive inside the product's grace, Aurelia Hanse Line notes the lateness on the booking's charge account. Set out here are the scope of that note, its effect and the tool the agent uses to write it.

## What is recorded

Instructions that miss the allocated sailing's SI cut-off yet arrive within grace are recorded as a single late shipping-instruction entry for that sailing, whatever amount the entry turns out to carry, including 0.00. A receipt of this kind that is already on the booking without its late entry is owed that entry and is recorded on the next occasion the booking is handled. The entry names the booking's allocated sailing, and its amount is expressed in US dollars to two decimal places.

## Effect on the account

The entry, coded `late_si_fee`, is added to the charge history and the outstanding charges rise by its amount; an entry of 0.00 records the late submission without charging anything. The booking's documents, sailing and status are not changed.

## Tool and invocation

The record is made with `record_late_si_fee_242ae989`. It is an agent tool held back from the default list: the agent unlocks it (`unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then invokes it (`call_agent_discoverable_tool`).

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `booking_id` | reference number of the booking whose shipping instructions were late, as returned by the booking lookup for the verified customer | identifier |
| `fee_usd` | the amount of the late entry in US dollars | non-negative decimal with two places, where 0.00 records the late submission free of charge; extra digits are rounded half-to-even |

The tool itself stamps the entry with the sailing the booking is currently allocated to and dates it on the day of the call. It records the booking's equipment type but no container count.

## Receipt

The response is a text rendering of a dictionary holding `booking_event_id`, `booking_id`, `charge_code` (always `late_si_fee`), `vessel_voyage` (the sailing the entry is recorded for), `amount_usd` (possibly 0.00), `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `charges_due_usd` (outstanding charges afterwards). Once a `booking_event_id` is returned, the entry is on the account.
